name: @aperio/locales
description: Shared UI translations for Aperio — consumed by the desktop frontend (Vite) and the mobile app (Expo/Metro) so both stay in one source of truth.
//: Plain JSON per language under <lang>/translation.json (i18next resource shape). Resolved via a path alias on each side (no bundler-specific main/exports), so deep imports like '@aperio/locales/de/translation.json' work in both Vite and Metro.
